cohort: 217 pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 and were treated at a COVID-19 clinic.
finding: Pregnant women with severe COVID-19, particularly in their third trimester, experienced more severe symptoms, required longer hospital stays, had a higher need for ICU admission, and were more likely to give birth prematurely.
mod_finding: The rate of Cesarean delivery was higher in the severe COVID-19 group.
